C0278.title: Sentencing Issues in Web Crawler Crimes: Analysis of 88 Sample Cases
C0278.summary: In January 2023, China Court Network published an article discussing sentencing issues based on 88 sample cases involving web crawler crimes, with a repost on a Shandong court website. The article states that sentencing was generally relatively lenient, the amount involved had a strong sentencing effect, and the social harm of crawler misuse, technical-abuse methods, and profit motives were not fully evaluated; it proposed stronger criminal enforcement and improved sentencing guidance.
